summary: Collection Spy is our new range of Basins, Toilets and Baths designed to elevate small spaces without compromising functionality.
title: Collection Spy
bodyHtml:
A New Era for Small Bathrooms

Discover the revolutionary Collection Spy by Studio Bagno, a versatile range of basins, toilets, and baths, designed to bring awe-inspiring aesthetics to small bathrooms without compromising functionality.

Discover Collection Spy

Design without Limits

Collection Spy Basins are available in various sizes and colours, featuring clever in-built shelf space to reduce the need for extensive vanity installations.

Spy can be bench mounted as a hero piece, but truly shines as a wall-mounted fixture, pairing beautifully with an under-bench or small vanity for increased storage space whilst maintaining a minimal footprint.

Thanks to their limited projection (some as small as 200mm!), they offer a stylish yet functional solution for any small bathroom.

Explore Collection Spy

Complete the Look - Rimless Toilets

The Synthesis Eco series of Italian made rimless toilets perfectly complement the Spy basins with their soft geometric features.

Designed to save floor space with it’s compact projection, Synthesis provides a comfortable and functional seating position, eliminating the need for a larger toilet.

Complete the Look - Lago Bath

The Lago Bath is ideal in small bathroom settings thanks to its compact size and stunning aesthetics. Lago offers a complete solution for your small bathroom fixtures, ensuring a cohesive and beautiful design.

Lago is made from MarmoTech - a formulation of premium stone composite materials that is 100% silica free. The result is a freestanding bath with a luxurious tactile finish, that not only feels exquisite but also warms quickly and helps maintain water temperature.
